title: i71

specs.material: Carbon Fiber Composite Shell with EPS Liner
specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
technical_analysis_2: Aerodynamic optimization is central to the i71's design philosophy, featuring a streamlined chin bar and integrated spoiler system that minimizes drag at high speeds. The acoustic profile has been tuned through extensive wind tunnel testing to reduce turbulence noise entering the ear cups, achieving a noise level of 82.5 dB at 100 km/h. This is further enhanced by the inclusion of HJC's proprietary ventilation channels which utilize thermal dynamics to draw cool air in and expel hot air out, significantly improving rider comfort during extended rides.
technical_analysis_3: Safety compliance is rigorous, with the i71 meeting both US DOT and European ECE 22.06 standards, ensuring it passes strict impact attenuation and penetration tests. The retention system employs a high-strength micro-adjustable YKK buckle that provides a secure lock even under extreme G-forces, while the interior padding utilizes moisture-wicking materials to prevent heat buildup. This combination of cutting-edge materials, aerodynamic shaping, and certified safety features makes the i71 a top-tier choice for performance-oriented riders seeking maximum protection with minimal weight.
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the HJC i71. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC i71: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the HJC I71 is engineered for everyday agility, rapid ventilation, and effortless usability. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1264g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~87 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle.

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Full Face lineup, the i71 brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The HJC I71 represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC I71 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
